candidate_workaround: Use PowerShell Select-String with an explicit pattern array for mixed quote and space searches, and evaluate each diagnostic command independently.
failure_signature: mixed-quote ripgrep inspection split part of the pattern into a filename and a later command masked the nonzero exit
recurrence_guard: Mixed-quote diagnostics use structured pattern arrays; multi-command diagnostics check every native exit code so later success cannot mask an earlier failure.
rollback: Retain the failed search and exclude it from inspection evidence; rely only on the explicit successful inspection.
scope_boundary: Owner-local diagnostic recovery only; no production, security-complete, privacy-complete, or authority credit.
title: Keep mixed-quote diagnostics structured and fail-visible
